description: This file defines 'AttachmentsAdapter', a RecyclerView.Adapter subclass responsible for displaying a list of 'Attachment' objects in an Android app. It manages view creation, data binding, item comparison for efficient updates, and handles payload-based partial updates.

classes.name: AttachmentsAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of attachments with diffing and partial update support.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes ViewHolder instances for attachment items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder, with support for payload-based partial updates.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a unique item ID based on the attachment's path hash code.

inner_classes.name: DiffCallback
inner_classes.description: Defines how to compare Attachment items for diffing purposes.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two attachments are the same based on their path.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the contents of two attachments are identical.

methods.name: getChangePayload
methods.description: Provides a specific payload when certain parts of the data change, for partial updates.

enums.name: Payload
enums.description: Enum representing specific types of partial updates for an attachment item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for an attachment item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds an attachment item to a ViewHolder, supporting payloads for partial updates.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Provides a unique stable ID for each attachment based on its path hash code.
